title: MEDICAL BIOCHEMISTRY II
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dipeptidase specific for dipeptides containing proline in the carboxyl position."
Prolidase is a dipeptidase specific for dipeptides containing proline in the carboxyl position.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a crucial reaction in nervous system; this was explained in section 2.4."
Decarboxylation of pyruvate is a crucial reaction in nervous system; this was explained in section 2.4.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a ketose while glyceraldehydes 3- phosphate is an aldose."
Dihydroxyacetone phosphate is a ketose while glyceraldehydes 3- phosphate is an aldose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the monomeric units of proteins."
Amino acids are the monomeric units of proteins.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the photoreceptor molecule present in the cones."
Iodopsin is the photoreceptor molecule present in the cones.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major source of oxaloacetate as the starting materials for the cycle."
Carboxylation of pyruvate is the major source of oxaloacetate as the starting materials for the cycle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the blood's capacity to bind iron with transferring."
Total iron binding capacity(TIBC) is a measure of the blood's capacity to bind iron with transferring.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of inborn errors of metabolism."
Albinism is an example of inborn errors of metabolism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the transport form while Ferritin is the storage form of iron."
Transferrin is the transport form while Ferritin is the storage form of iron.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential cofactor in the conversion of homocysteine to methionine and in the conversion of methyl malonylcoA to succinyl-coA."
Cobalamin is an essential cofactor in the conversion of homocysteine to methionine and in the conversion of methyl malonylcoA to succinyl-coA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the carrier for acetyl groups obtained from the degradation of carbohydrates and lipids. iii."
Coenzyme A is the carrier for acetyl groups obtained from the degradation of carbohydrates and lipids. iii.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the chemical elements required by living organisms, other than the four elements carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen present in common organic molecules."
Dietary minerals are the chemical elements required by living organisms, other than the four elements carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen present in common organic molecules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a co-enzyme in the decarboxylation of pyruvate and α- ketoglutarate and also in transketolase and transaldolase reactions. iii."
TPP is a co-enzyme in the decarboxylation of pyruvate and α- ketoglutarate and also in transketolase and transaldolase reactions. iii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to make urea which is excreted in the urine."
Free excess ammonia is used to make urea which is excreted in the urine.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the black pigment of human skin, it is synthesized inside the melanocytes from tyrosine."
Melanin is the black pigment of human skin, it is synthesized inside the melanocytes from tyrosine.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important source of precursors or building blocks for the synthesis of molecules such as amino acids, purine bases, cholesterol and porphyrins."
The TCA cycle is an important source of precursors or building blocks for the synthesis of molecules such as amino acids, purine bases, cholesterol and porphyrins.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the prosthetic group of two important TCA cycle enzymes; pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutatrate dehydrogenase."
Thiamine pyrophosphate is the prosthetic group of two important TCA cycle enzymes; pyruvate dehydrogenase and α-ketoglutatrate dehydrogenase.
fib: ______ is a precursor of co-enzyme A, that participates in acyl transfer reactions. ii.
Pantothenate
Pantothenate is a precursor of co-enzyme A, that participates in acyl transfer reactions. ii.
______ is the highest in adult tissue.
Se Concentration in testis
Se Concentration in testis is the highest in adult tissue.
______ is the sequence of reactions that converts glucose into pyruvate with the production of ATP.
Glycolysis
Glycolysis is the sequence of reactions that converts glucose into pyruvate with the production of ATP.
______ are used mainly to synthesize proteins, but they also serve as precursors for a variety of nitrogenous compounds.
Free amino acids
Free amino acids are used mainly to synthesize proteins, but they also serve as precursors for a variety of nitrogenous compounds.
______ is a non protein component of an enzyme (cofactor) which is organic in nature.
coenzyme
A coenzyme is a non protein component of an enzyme (cofactor) which is organic in nature.
______ is the richest dietary source of carotenoids.
Palm-oil
Palm-oil is the richest dietary source of carotenoids.
______ is a complex disease that affects several hundred million people.
Diabetes mellitus
Diabetes mellitus is a complex disease that affects several hundred million people.
______ is the central molecule in carbohydrate metabolism since all the major pathways of carbohydrates metabolism are connected with it.
Glucose
Glucose is the central molecule in carbohydrate metabolism since all the major pathways of carbohydrates metabolism are connected with it.
______ is the final common pathway for the oxidation of fuel molecules (protein, fatty acids and carbohydrates) to energy, carbon dioxide and water.
citric acid cycle
The citric acid cycle is the final common pathway for the oxidation of fuel molecules (protein, fatty acids and carbohydrates) to energy, carbon dioxide and water.
______ is the source of the acetyl coA in the cytosol, which is used for the synthesis of fats, other lipids and some amino acids.
Citrate
Citrate is the source of the acetyl coA in the cytosol, which is used for the synthesis of fats, other lipids and some amino acids.
______ are the major source of energy for the living cells.
Carbohydrates
Carbohydrates are the major source of energy for the living cells.
______ is the thiolytic cleavage of the bond in the 3- ketoderivative by an incoming CoA to yield acetyl CoA and the shortened fatty acyl CoA.
final reaction
Thiolysis The final reaction is the thiolytic cleavage of the bond in the 3- ketoderivative by an incoming CoA to yield acetyl CoA and the shortened fatty acyl CoA.
______ is the sum of all of the chemical reactions that take place in an organism.
Metabolism
Metabolism is the sum of all of the chemical reactions that take place in an organism.
______ is the most important preventable cause of blindness in the world.
deficiency
Deficiency of Vitamin A Vitamin A deficiency is the most important preventable cause of blindness in the world.
______ is the main nitrogenous excretory product of amino acids and protein metabolism in most terrestrial vertebrates; these animals are referred to as ureotelic organisms.
Urea
Urea is the main nitrogenous excretory product of amino acids and protein metabolism in most terrestrial vertebrates; these animals are referred to as ureotelic organisms.
______ is the hydrolysis of complex food molecules into smaller water soluble molecules that can easily be absorbed by the gastrointestinal tract for utilization by the cells.
Digestion
Digestion is the hydrolysis of complex food molecules into smaller water soluble molecules that can easily be absorbed by the gastrointestinal tract for utilization by the cells.
______ is used to supply building blocks for the synthesis of various biological molecules.
pathway
The pathway is used to supply building blocks for the synthesis of various biological molecules.
